replies.body:
At the moment, due to some restructuring of ranks and other minor issues, TeamSpeak is limited to only staff. We hope to have this situation resolved very soon (few hours). Someone will post an update when the server is open to regular users.

Thanks for your patience in this time of transition,
ALM
